analyst_view.overall: A bottom-of-the-table meeting: Udinese are 19th with 6 points and still without a home win, Fiorentina 16th with 9 after a 3-0 defeat at Monza, so both badly need the points. Udinese's new coach Paolo Zanetti got a 1-1 draw at Bologna with Zaniolo scoring; Keinan Davis is still doubtful and Zanetti does not want to rush him, while Bertola, Gueye and Ebosse are out and Karlstrom is one booking from a ban. Fiorentina coach Vanoli has taken the squad into a training camp; the club has publicly backed him, but Florence press call this a must-not-lose game and expect a more cautious, balanced side, with Brescianini or an extra midfielder and Ranieri next to Dragusin if Viery is not fit; Pongracic and Parisi are out. The numbers now count Davis, Gueye, Pongracic and Viery, plus referee Federico La Penna (4.2 cards a game, +15%); I only lean slightly lower on goals and on target and slightly higher on cards for the tension.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals; they already take Davis and Gueye off Udinese, add a little for Viery's absence in Fiorentina's defence, and add for Fiorentina's recent scoring and the head-to-head. What they can't see is Vanoli's planned switch to a more cautious, compact shape after the Monza defeat, in a nervous relegation game, so I lean mildly lower to about 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.3 corners and already add a little for both teams winning more corners than usual lately. Udinese's wing-backs (Vojvoda or Abankwah, Kamara) and Fiorentina's wide players such as Njie keep play on the flanks, while a more cautious Fiorentina pulls the other way, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards and already add about 15% for referee Federico La Penna (4.2 cards a game), while taking some off because both sides, Udinese especially, have been booked less than expected lately. This is a tense six-pointer with Fiorentina in a training camp and Vanoli under heavy pressure, which the numbers don't count, so I add 4%, to about 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers expect 29.8 shots and already push them up for recent form: Fiorentina have shot 93 times in six games and both teams allow plenty. Udinese without a natural striker (Zaniolo leading the line if Davis is out) may shoot more from distance, while a more cautious Fiorentina may shoot less, so these roughly balance and I stay at about 30.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target, already raised a lot for recent form (Fiorentina +15%, Udinese +7%). Davis's absence is only counted on goals; without him Udinese's attempts are more likely to come from distance, and Fiorentina plan a safer set-up, so I lean slightly lower, to about 9.6.
